svg.title: IRIS. See it. Pick it. Sort it. A 3D-printed six-axis arm that identifies and sorts parts.
svg.desc: A six-axis arm in 3D on a floor grid. Cubes ride a conveyor, an overhead camera classifies each one, and the arm lifts it into the matching tray while a readout tracks all six joint angles.
